headline: Public hearing on Green Street Manor, two duplexes at 12 Green Street, Peace Dale; also 74 Main Street and People's Credit Union signage.
summary: The agenda includes a public hearing on Green Street Manor, a plan to build two duplexes with four units. It also covers a 74 Main Street accessory structure and a sign change request for People's Credit Union.
items: 74 Main Street: minor land development project for an accessory structure with 2 dwelling units, with a request to waive street and perimeter landscaping requirements. Assessor's Plat 57-1, Lot 78. Owner and applicant: 74 Main Street, LLC.

Public hearing on Green Street Manor: major multi-household land development project, preliminary plan review, at 12 Green Street, Peace Dale. Assessor's Plat 49-1, Lot 148. Two duplexes (4 units total) with parking and stormwater management. Applicant and owner: Jonnycake Center for Hope. Continued from September 22, 2026.

People's Credit Union: change to an approved plan to add a pylon sign and internal directional signage. 703 Kingstown Road, Assessor's Plat 51-1, Lot 92. Owner: People's Credit Union. Applicant: CT Sign.
location: South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879
